2026-05-12 — session focused on knowledge-pack design, doc maintenance, and store hygiene.

SESSION ARC:
1. Filed #115 (rvr pack install — text packs via git URL). Four open design questions in the issue body: default scope (project vs global), namespace ownership (manifest vs install-time), collision/override semantics, update model.
2. Filed #116 (executable packs) — then immediately reconsidered when surface overlap with Claude Code skills + MCPs became obvious. Closed #116 same day, rationale saved as context.execPacksRejected with an explicit revisit trigger (cross-agent procedural-distribution gap, project.goals #4).
3. docs/ROADMAP.md refreshed: v1.0.0 launch acknowledgment + CHANGELOG link, added #84 (entry health) and #115 (packs), dropped dead #46 link and stale Go-rewrite tailpiece, added v1.0.0 Release History entry framing pre-launch versions as codexCLI-era.
4. SECURITY.md Supported Versions table bumped 1.6.x → 1.0.x (8 minor versions stale).
5. Committed as 5ca2423. Rebase conflict on _epoch.json (origin 1656, mine 1642) resolved to 1658 = max + my-deltas to preserve monotonicity.

NEXT SESSION:
- Run `git log origin/main..HEAD` early — if 5ca2423 is still unpushed, decide whether to push.
- Pack work (#115) is post-v1.15 territory, not urgent. The four design questions in the issue body are the right starting point if implementation begins.

DON'T:
- Re-derive the executable-pack rejection — context.execPacksRejected covers it with a revisit trigger.
- Re-do today's ROADMAP/SECURITY sweep.
- Bootstrap-flag bunMigrationScope/devWorkflow as stale — they were refreshed in de750b4 (2026-05-08) before this session bootstrapped; the session-start snapshot just predated that commit. Verify by reading the actual entries, not the bootstrap summary.

USER STATE: light maintenance session. Doc cleanup + new feature design. Reverie itself is healthy and not consuming engineering bandwidth; the user is in commercial/comms mode (Phase 4/5 per project.commercialContext + project.releasePlan).
